name: codex-status-board
description: Get notified when Codex tasks complete, with highly visible and audio alerts.

commands.title: Codex Task Notifier: Open Status Board
Codex Task Notifier: Refresh Status Board

codexTaskNotifier.minimumActivitySeconds.description: Keep quick turns quiet. Show Working and enable alerts after this many seconds of ongoing activity, or earlier for a detected edit. Set 0 for all turns. Reload the window after changing.

codexTaskNotifier.detectFileEdits.description: Use matching local Codex session transcripts to recognize apply_patch calls and show Working before the activity threshold. No transcript content is transmitted. Reload the window after changing.

codexTaskNotifier.autoOpen.description: Open or select the board when a task starts.

codexTaskNotifier.notifications.description: Show a VS Code notification when a task finishes.

codexTaskNotifier.detectionMode.description: Automatic includes chat completion inferred from read-state logs. Conservative requires a turn-diff completion marker. Reload the window after changing.

codexTaskNotifier.codexLogPath.description: Optional absolute Codex.log path for a different extension host. Normally detected automatically. Reload the window after changing.
